[FECR25](3_portfolio/FECR25/synData7_FECR25.html)

`fixest` and `clubSandwich` are widely used R packages for working with TWFE models. This post demonstrates that `clubSandwich` currently does not support `fixest`-style models in general. However, there are some workarounds that compromise the high-performance algorithms of `fixest` while enabling compatibility with `clubSandwich`.

Keywords: R, TWFE, CRSE

<!-- Code stored in rProject -->

------------------------------------------------------------------------

[CRSE25](3_portfolio/CRSE25/synData6_clusterRobustStandardErrors.html)

Panel data may involve irregular time intervals between observations, leading to within-cluster correlation. This post examines how two-way fixed effects (TWFE) models are affected when applied to such data and discusses the use of cluster-robust standard errors (CRSE) to correct for the resulting issues.

Keywords: panel data, CRSE, TWFE
